parameters.content:
## Load or create the schema
Reuses the schema tab if it exists. Otherwise an LLM describes each column header and saves the result as a new tab you can edit.

## Smart Table Fill

Fills the empty columns of a Google Sheet from free text. You only name the columns: an LLM works out what each one means, and then extracts the values.

### How it works
1. Reads the rows of your sheet (or items sent by a parent workflow) and takes the text in `Text_to_interpret`.
2. On the first run, an LLM describes every column header and saves the result as a schema tab (`Description_hig7f6`). Later runs reuse it, so you can edit types, descriptions and allowed values there.
3. Turns the schema into a strict JSON structure. An LLM extracts the fields from each row's text, up to 10 per call. Values a parent workflow already knows are written as they are.
4. Writes the values back into the row with the same `email`, or appends a new row.
5. If a row fails, it is still written, with the reason in `extraction_error`. The other rows continue.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Create a sheet with headers in row 1, including `email` and `Text_to_interpret`. Add `extraction_error` to see failures
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets OAuth2 on the Sheets nodes and an LLM credential on both model nodes
- [ ] In **Get Rows in Sheet**, pick your spreadsheet and tab
- [ ] Fill `email` and `Text_to_interpret` in a few rows, then click **Test workflow**

### Customization
- Change defaults in **String Input**, such as `match_same_row` (false = append), `batch_size`, `text_column` or `schema_sheet_name`
- Call it from another workflow with `spreadsheet_id`, `data_sheet_name` and the text
- An optional email-CRM branch ships disabled (bottom right)

[Setup guide](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/02_smart-table-fill/docs/setup-guide.md) · [Project page](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/02_smart-table-fill/README.md) · A whole Drive folder? [smart-folder2table](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/02_smart-table-fill/workflows/smart-folder2table.json)

## Extract fields with an LLM
One call per row and up to `batch_size` columns. Known values and empty texts skip the LLM. Optional [confidence scores](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/docs/observability-through-llm-confidence-estimate.md).

## Write rows to the sheet
Updates the row with the same `email`, or appends when `match_same_row` is false. Failed rows get `extraction_error`.

## Email CRM (optional)
Ships disabled. Set `YOUR_APPS_SCRIPT_ID`,
then enable all three nodes.
[Guide](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/02_smart-table-fill/docs/email-crm-guide.md) · [Apps Script setup](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/02_smart-table-fill/docs/apps-script-execution-api-setup.md)

## Choose rows
Manual runs read every row of your sheet. A parent workflow can send its own items instead.

### Set this first
Pick your spreadsheet and data tab in **Get Rows in Sheet**. This node reads both from there and holds every other default.

### Point this at your workflow
Import [contact-memory-update.json](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/02_smart-table-fill/workflows/subworkflows/contact-memory-update.json), then select it here.

### If it stops here

A column has Type `class` but an empty `Classes` field.

**Fix:** add comma-separated values in the schema tab, or change the Type to `str`.

### If it stops here

- Put column names into row 1 of your data tab.
- Or delete a broken `Description_hig7f6` tab and re-run.

## Inputs
Passthrough of all fields from CRM Prep Email Store Input:
emails_folder_id, folder_id, email_subject, body_core, contact_name, contact_email, direction, owner_name

### If it stops here

The data tab name is wrong.

**Fix:** pick the right tab in **Get Rows in Sheet**.

### If it stops here

Your `Description_hig7f6` tab exists but is broken.

**Fix:** delete that tab and re-run to regenerate it.

### If it stops here

Hitting LLM rate limits (e.g. 5 requests/min on a free tier)? See [rate limits](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/troubleshooting.md#rate-limit-errors-http-429).

### If it stops here

403 after a GCP project change? See [troubleshooting](https://github.com/runfish5/micro-services/blob/main/projects/n8n/troubleshooting.md#403-permission-errors-incl-gcp-project-migration).

parameters.text:
=You are a database schema expert. Given these column names from a spreadsheet:
{{ $('Fetch Data Sheet Headers').first().json.values[0] }}

Generate a schema definition for each column. Output a JSON array where each item has:
- ColumnName: the exact column name (preserve case)
- Type: one of [str, int, date, list, class]
- Description: brief description (10 words max) of what this field stores
- Classes: if Type is "class", provide 2-4 comma-separated enum values; otherwise empty string

Type guidelines:
- date: timestamps, birthdays, created_at, updated_at, any date field
- int: IDs, counts, frequencies, ages, numeric identifiers
- list: multiple values (emails, phones, jobs, tags, anything plural)
- class: categorical/status fields (use Classes for enum values)
- str: everything else (names, addresses, notes, single text values)

IMPORTANT: Output ONLY the JSON array, no explanation.

=Extract the fields of the JSON schema below from the source text.

{{ ($json.contact_name || $json.contact_email || $json.subject) ? '<context>\nContact: ' + ($json.contact_name || '') + '\nEmail: ' + ($json.contact_email || '') + '\nSubject: ' + ($json.subject || '') + '\n</context>\n\n' : '' }}<source_text>
{{ $json.body_core }}
</source_text>

Rules:
- Use only what the text states. Do not guess, round or reword values.
- A field the text does not mention: empty string "" (empty list for lists).
- Fields with fixed options: one of the options, or "" if the text does not say.
- confidence.overall: 0-100 for the values as a whole. Missing or guessed values lower it.
/no_think

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const id = Date.now() % 1000000; const name = $('String Input').first().json.schema_sheet_name; const rows = $input.first().json.output; return JSON.stringify({ requests: [{ addSheet: { properties: { sheetId: id, title: name } } }, { updateCells: { rows: [{ values: ["ColumnName","Type","Description","Classes"].map(h => ({ userEnteredValue: { stringValue: h } })) }].concat(rows.map(r => ({ values: ["ColumnName","Type","Description","Classes"].map(c => ({ userEnteredValue: { stringValue: String(r[c]||"") } })) }))), fields: "userEnteredValue", start: { sheetId: id, rowIndex: 0, columnIndex: 0 } } }] }); })() }}
